units.title: SG-2 Author inventory item icon sources and register them
Act: Author item icon grids and add them to ART_SOURCES
Act: Run art:generate to emit item PNGs and manifest entries
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Blocked: the unit's precondition is not met. The brief says to run art:generate "With ITEM_SOURCES in ART_SOURCES", but no ITEM_SOURCES exists in game/frontend/src/art/ (sources.ts spreads only BOY_SOURCES, ROOM_SOURCES and SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES), and no item/ sources are in git history. Without it, art:generate cannot emit the six item PNGs or manifest entries, so Step 1's expected result cannot be met. Creating the six item pixel grids is new art authoring outside this unit, so I did not write them. Also, the run failed before generating anything: game/frontend/node_modules has no zod, and game/node_modules is absent (zod is declared in game/package.json, so an install is needed). The worktree is clean: no files were changed. To unblock, add ITEM_SOURCES (six item/ entries: old-key, note, book, coin, flashlight, photo, 16x16) to ART_SOURCES in game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts, or run the unit that adds them first, then install zod and re-run Step 1.
